summary: The v5 pipeline (scripts/transfer_analysis_v5/) is the "one clean run" that produces every table for the ACCV 2026 Regime-Direction paper. run_v5.sh has 7 stages: (1) v4/verify_regime_direction.py -> regime_direction_verification/{REPORT.md, REPORT_dino.md, master_table_mean_nn{,_dino}.csv} (the law, Table 1); (2) rule_holdout_checks.py -> results/rule_holdout_checks.csv; (3) asym_vs_sym_table.py -> results/asym_vs_sym.csv; (4) v4/experiments.py + bootstrap.py -> v4/results_rule_v5core/{summary.csv, bootstrap_gap.csv, summary_points_peak_pck.csv, predictions/peak_pck/rows_*} (Table 2/4); (5) v4/regenerate_consensus_csv.py -> CONSENSUS_RULE.csv (Table 3); (6) make_policy_rows.py (builds rows_*_motion_policy.csv) + v4/pairwise_gap_analysis.py -> results/pairwise_gap_rule.csv + v4/selection_regret.py -> results/selection_regret_rule.csv (Table 5); (7) intervention_oos_test.py -> results/intervention_oos.csv (Sec 7.3 OOS test). Outside run_v5.sh: ceiling_oracles.py -> ceiling_oracles.csv; controls_fresh.py -> controls_fresh.csv; per_regime_linear.py -> per_regime_linear_summary*.csv + per_regime_featureset_comparison*.csv; conditional_combination.py, loao_weight_transfer.py, policy_vs_fit_regret.py, joint_anchor.py -> their namesake CSVs; appearance_motion_decomposition.py -> decomp_*.csv + ACCV_2026/tables/tab_decomp.tex; v4/context_scale_calibration.py -> benchsim_rule/ and benchsim_sym/ (make_policy_rows.py -> benchsim_policy/); blocks.py (invoked via update_tables.py for the Obsidian vault) side-effect-writes results/intervention_breakdown.csv; l_directional_check.py prints only; make_figures{,_v2,_v3}.py, make_intervention_summary.py, make_recovery_figure.py, make_splat_composite.py -> results/figures/ + ACCV figures; compile_master_reference.py is RETIRED. make_paper_tables.py renders the .tex tables: tab_law (master_table_mean_nn.csv + asym_vs_sym.csv sym/w2 cols), tab_law_dino (master_table_mean_nn_dino.csv + transfer_table_nomid.csv + pairwise_self_distances.csv), tab_predictors (v5core summary.csv ctx_rho_g, fallback computed from rows files for motion_policy/meannn families), tab_perregime_ablation + tab_regime_linear (asym_vs_sym.csv + per_regime_linear_summary.csv), tab_oos + tab_dirtest (intervention_oos.csv + asym_vs_sym.csv), tab_utility + tab_supp_gap (selection_regret_rule.csv + pairwise_gap_rule.csv), tab_supp_asym (asym_vs_sym.csv), tab_supp_eps (eps_rule_table.csv), tab_supp_oracles (ceiling_oracles.csv), tab_supp_controls (controls_fresh.csv), tab_supp_featuresets (per_regime_featureset_comparison.csv), tab_supp_dino (master_table_mean_nn_dino.csv). Current results/ is the post-Middlebury-exclusion regeneration (9 benchmarks, 891 rows); results_with_middlebury_backup/ preserves the contaminated 2026-06-10 02:27 state (10 benchmarks, 990 rows, TT arm n=3, drop_benchmark_middlebury control row, plus joint_anchor_v2_session_original.csv). Most .tex tables (mtime 22:04, tab_decomp 00:02) are consistent with the current CSVs — I verified tab_utility, tab_oos, tab_dirtest, tab_regime_linear, tab_perregime_ablation, tab_law cell-by-cell. However: tab_supp_gap.tex is wrong (its pivot averages accuracy over all four predictor families instead of the rule); eps_rule_table.csv feeding tab_supp_eps.tex is byte-identical to the contaminated backup and has no generating script; the README "Key numbers" block and several script docstrings still describe the pre-exclusion run; and the run_v5.sh defaults read transfer_table.csv, which currently still CONTAINS middlebury, so a verbatim re-run would re-contaminate the artifacts.
